natural_dialogue.description: Assesses the warmth and engagement level of the response, including the use of appropriate personality and emojis.

accepted_values.1: Very formal, lacks warmth and engagement.
accepted_values.5: Highly conversational, very warm and engaging with expressive use of personality/emojis.

coherence.description: Evaluates the logical flow and clarity of the response.

accepted_values.4: Mostly coherent, clear and easy to follow.
accepted_values.5: Fully coherent, very clear and logical.

listening_and_turn_taking.description: Measures how well the response acknowledges the user's input and promotes further dialogue.

accepted_values.2: Minimal acknowledgment, does not encourage further dialogue.
accepted_values.3: Some acknowledgment, limited invitation for follow-up.
accepted_values.5: Excellent acknowledgment, actively fosters engaging dialogue.

avoiding_boilerplate.description: Assesses the extent to which the response avoids unnecessary disclaimers and stiff corporate phrasing.

accepted_values.2: Some boilerplate language, but not overly much.

accuracy_and_helpfulness.description: Evaluates the factual accuracy and practicality of the information provided in the response.

accepted_values.2: Some accurate information, but lacks helpfulness.
